title: The Welch function is not third-order sum-free: paper and checking programs
description:
Final revision of the paper, single column, 9 pages, with its LaTeX source and the programs that check its statements on small fields. The paper proves Conjecture 5.10 of X. Hou and S. Zhao, Further results on sum-freedom of binary and q-ary functions (arXiv:2609.31489): for n = 2m+1 at least 7 the Welch function X^(2^m+3) on F_(2^n) is not third-order sum-free. With u = x^(2^m), the kernel Z(x) of the linearised polynomial of Hou and Zhao has dimension 3 exactly when Tr(1/(x+u)) = Tr(xu/(x+u)) = 1, the number of such x is (2^n + 1 - 3K_n)/4 with K_n the Kloosterman sum of F_(2^n), and Weil's bound makes it positive for n at least 7. Every statement is proved by hand; no statement rests on the programs.

The results were first made public on 9 October 2026 as release v1.0.0 of this repository (later versions archived under the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23553009). An earlier and incomplete version of the paper appeared on Hexagon as hexagon:2610.00472.
